semantics.original_evidence: The two-input XNOR of in1 and in2 feeds a two-input XOR whose second input is in3.
semantics.timing: Combinational gates; no clock, state, or added latency.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No initialized state; output follows current inputs after combinational settling.

numeric.unknowns: Ordinary Verilog gate semantics propagate x/z at any input to x at out.

verification.oracle: Explicit binary truth table derived from the original XNOR then XOR circuit; unknown inputs checked with case equality.
verification.coverage: All eight binary combinations and all 64 combinations over 0,1,x,z.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then wait one testbench time unit for combinational settling.
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch or bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks.
